children: Baidu Group said its previously announced voluntary conversion of its Hong Kong Stock Exchange secondary listing status to a dual primary listing took effect on September 1, 2026. The company is now dual primary listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and Nasdaq Global Select Market, and its ordinary shares in Hong Kong and American depositary shares on Nasdaq will remain convertible, according to Jiemian News.

title: Baidu’s Hong Kong Listing Converts to Dual Primary Listing
